verses.text: Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the DOMNUL has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the DOMNUL has commanded. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the DOMNUL had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

They received from Moise all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They a vorbit lui Moise, saying, The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the DOMNUL commanded to make. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He made fifty clasps of să pleceld, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
He made curtains of să pleceats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He overlaid the boards with să pleceld, and made their rings of să pleceld as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with să pleceld.
He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with să pleceld. Their hooks were of să pleceld. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with să pleceld, and their five sockets were of bronze.
